issues.location: Segundo a McKinsey, recomendações de produto respondem por 10-30% da receita de e-commerce.
issues.explanation: The '10-30% of e-commerce revenue from recommendations' stat is a known fabricated benchmark never actually published by McKinsey. It is on the explicit debunked list regardless of attribution.

issues.location: O Baymard Institute indica uplift médio de AOV de 8-15% com cross-sell implementado.
issues.explanation: The '8-15% AOV uplift with cross-sell' figure attributed to Baymard Institute is a debunked fabricated benchmark — Baymard has never published this statistic.

issues.location: Segundo estudo da Bazaarvoice/Spiegel, produtos com 50+ reviews convertem 2-3x mais que produtos sem reviews.
issues.explanation: The '50+ reviews convert 2-3x more' claim is a known debunked misquote. The actual Spiegel Research Center finding was that 5 reviews produce a 270% lift — the '50+ reviews / 2-3x' version is a fabricated variant of that stat.

issues.location: McKinsey: recomendações de produto geram 10-30% da receita e-commerce
issues.explanation: This is repeated in the References section. The '10-30% of e-commerce revenue from recommendations' attributed to McKinsey is a confirmed fabricated benchmark and should not appear anywhere in the report.

issues.location: Bazaarvoice / Spiegel: produtos com 50+ reviews convertem 2-3x
issues.explanation: Repeated in the References section. The '50+ reviews / 2-3x conversion' stat is a debunked fabrication; the real Spiegel finding concerns 5 reviews at 270% lift.

issues.location: Baymard Institute: cross-sell gera uplift médio de AOV de 8-15%
issues.explanation: Repeated in the References section. Baymard Institute never published an '8-15% AOV uplift from cross-sell' figure; this is a known debunked benchmark.

summary: The report correctly handles the Deloitte stat and avoids most pitfalls, but contains four distinct fabricated benchmarks (McKinsey 10-30% revenue, Baymard 8-15% AOV, Spiegel 50+ reviews 2-3x, and their repetition in the References section) that must be removed or corrected before publication.

edits.original: Segundo a McKinsey, recomendações de produto respondem por 10-30% da receita de e-commerce. O Baymard Institute indica uplift médio de AOV de 8-15% com cross-sell implementado.
edits.fixed: Segundo a McKinsey, personalização — incluindo recomendações de produto — pode gerar entre 5-15% de incremento de receita (McKinsey, 2021).
edits.rationale: The '10-30% of e-commerce revenue' McKinsey stat is a confirmed fabricated benchmark and must be removed. Replaced with the verified McKinsey personalization stat (5-15% revenue lift, 2021). The Baymard '8-15% AOV uplift' claim is also a confirmed fabricated benchmark with no verified source and is removed entirely, with no replacement.

edits.original: Segundo estudo da Bazaarvoice/Spiegel, produtos com 50+ reviews convertem 2-3x mais que produtos sem reviews.
edits.fixed: Segundo estudo do Spiegel Research Center, produtos com 5 ou mais avaliações apresentam 270% mais probabilidade de conversão do que produtos sem avaliações (Spiegel Research Center, 2017).
edits.rationale: The '50+ reviews / 2-3x conversion' variant is a known fabricated misquote of the Spiegel stat. Replaced with the correct verified finding: 5+ reviews → 270% higher purchase likelihood (Spiegel Research Center, 2017).

edits.rationale: The '10-30% of e-commerce revenue from recommendations' attributed to McKinsey is a confirmed fabricated benchmark. Replaced with the verified McKinsey personalization stat in the References section.

edits.fixed: Spiegel Research Center: produtos com 5+ avaliações têm 270% mais probabilidade de conversão (2017)
edits.rationale: The '50+ reviews / 2-3x' variant is a debunked fabrication. Replaced with the correct Spiegel Research Center finding in the References section.
